tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. The default ground for everything.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Cards, editors, and inputs that sit on paper. Separate from paper with a line-strong hairline, never a shadow.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: Wells and quiet panels: side rails, code blocks, the artifact footer.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on paper, raised, sunk, and highlight (11.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on paper, raised, and sunk (5.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only. Too light for control borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders, input outlines, and the hairline around raised surfaces (3.3:1 on paper).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Links, the primary button, focus rings, and the revision t in the mark. Text on paper, raised, and sunk (6.2:1 or better). One primary action per view.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an action fill (7.6:1).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The highlighter. Marks the one thing a reader must not miss: a key decision, an open question, a changed line. A background behind ink text only, never text itself, never more than a phrase or a line.

tokens.name: evidence
tokens.usage: The [E] evidence tag and its text, on paper, raised, and sunk (5.2:1 or better). Always paired with the letter E, never color alone.

tokens.name: assumption
tokens.usage: The [A] assumption tag and its text, on paper, raised, and sunk (5.1:1 or better). Always paired with the letter A, never color alone.

tokens.name: synthetic
tokens.usage: The [S] synthetic tag and the synthetic label, on paper, raised, and sunk (6.1:1 or better). Always paired with the letter S and the word synthetic.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, on paper and raised (6.5:1 or better). Pair with an icon and words; never the only signal.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a tag and its text; icon padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between related items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding, card padding on small screens, gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; gap between sections within a card.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page margins on wide screens; space above a page title.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, the highlighter, inputs. Draftt is nearly square: it should feel like paper, not plastic.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, panels, menus.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Progress dots and avatars only. Never buttons.
